method: At the first thick HISM submission, capture the natural instance transform. After a spawn hit reveals the drone collision component, write that component transform along x through the captured instance. State is forced to 7 every tick after tick 12; timers +0x180/+0x1a8/+0x1ac are cleared in the same write. No truth or sensor value is used for control.
limitations: controlled component sweep, not natural flight
stage injection and repeated state writes are development interventions
other source components are present during the sweep
index candidate +0x58 is runtime attribution, not independent ABI
